verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Bridge sandbox for testing the stablecoin orchestration integration without moving real money, and Stripe sandboxes provisioned with working API keys via the CLI. Neither item shows that the sandbox covers stablecoin payments, stablecoin payouts and conversions end to end, or that it provides deterministic test values. missing for 10: explicit test-mode coverage of crypto/stablecoin payments, payouts, and conversions; documented deterministic test values or test wallets; hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rehearse everything without real funds — a documented sandbox or testnet mode covering payments, payouts, and conversions with test values that behave deterministically

citations.quote: Bridge has a sandbox environment for you to quickly begin testing your integration without having to move real money.
provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys. No account registration required.
